question: Where is the Gayā sacred site proclaimed to be located on the sacred body?
premises: The Gayā sacred site is named.
Its location is specified as in the belly.
Its location is further specified as in the north.
inference: The Gayā sacred site is proclaimed to be located in the northern part of the belly.
plain_english: And the Gayā sacred site is proclaimed to be in the belly, in the north.
